    # Stack the four 3-row layers; where layers overlap, retain the
    # foreground color in order 5 > 4 > 2 > 8.
    layers = [grid[i:i + 3] for i in range(0, 12, 3)]

    out = []

            row.append(max(colors, key=lambda color: priority[color]) if colors else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
